descricao_original: The myenteric (Auerbach’s) plexus lies between the layers of the muscularis externa throughout the tubular digestive system, providing autonomic innervation to the smooth muscle of muscularis externa. The plexus is a network of unmyelinated axons and ganglia, whose large neuronal cell bodies give rise to the postganglionic parasympathetic fibers in the plexus. Trichrome stain, 1000x
